skills.name: use-paper-api
skills.description: Use when you need structured data from the paper "When Does Personality Composition Matter for Multi-Agent LLM Teams?" (COLM 2026). Fetch /api/paper.json for metadata, links, and BibTeX, or /api/results.json for the result tables, instead of scraping the HTML project page.

skills.name: cite-the-paper
skills.description: Use when the user asks how to cite the paper "When Does Personality Composition Matter for Multi-Agent LLM Teams?" or needs its BibTeX, DOI, arXiv ID, or venue. Returns the exact citation block and identifiers.

skills.name: answer-from-results
skills.description: Use when answering quantitative questions about the paper "When Does Personality Composition Matter for Multi-Agent LLM Teams?" — phi shifts, milestone deltas, Cohen's d, bargaining acceptance rates, or which conditions/models were tested. Read /api/results.json and quote exact numbers with their condition and model.
